title: code_index.file_hash_snapshot response
description: A seq-bound batch of current file hashes for stale-diagnostic and background-check binding.

seq.description: Current code-index version-log sequence when the snapshot was captured.

captured_at_ms.description: Wall-clock capture time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used for current and indexed hashes.

snapshot.description: Direct workspace-relative path to decimal FNV-1a hash map suitable for verification_diagnostic_classify.

missing.description: Workspace-relative paths whose current bytes could not be read.

path.description: Workspace-relative path when resolvable; otherwise the caller-supplied path.

known.description: True when the path is currently present in the code-index file table.

readable.description: True when the current on-disk bytes were readable inside the workspace.

hash.description: Decimal-encoded FNV-1a 64-bit hash of current bytes, or null when unreadable.

hash_source.description: Whether the current hash reused fresh code-index metadata, read disk bytes, or could not be produced.

size.description: Current byte length, or null when unreadable.

mtime_ms.description: Current mtime in milliseconds since epoch, or null when unavailable.

indexed_hash.description: Decimal-encoded hash last observed by the index, or null when not indexed.

indexed_mtime_ms.description: Mtime last observed by the index, or null when not indexed.

last_edit_seq.description: Latest version-log sequence recorded for this path, or 0 when none exists.
